name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server for searching the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace + Degen Arena + portfolio risk scoring + cross-portfolio composition. Exposes 39 tools — v0.12.1 adds a marketplace slice ({v1,v2,both}; default flipped to 'v2') to acp_marketplace_gap surfacing Metabot v1.10.1's V1/V2 split. Other tools unchanged: v0.12.0 paid Phase 3 offerings (acp_search_narrative, acp_agent_risk_check) plus 9 v1.10 fields on acp_find, v0.10.0 composites (acp_hire_decision, acp_safe_quote, acp_portfolio_status), OracleBot Resource wrappers, v0.9.1 risk bundle, Degen Arena tools, and the v0.7+ Resources / cost / feed-address suite — backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
